title: Sukkah 7a — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 7 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-007.htm), questions 1–2.

questions.q: A sukkah made from 2 parallel walls (like an alleyway) — what must be done for the third side?
options: A full third wall in the middle
A tefach-wide wall on any side
A tefach-wide wall in the middle
A board of 4+ tefachim within 3 tefachim of one wall
questions.explain: Rav Yehuda's ruling (a tefach, positioned anywhere) and the harder no-standard-walls case (a 4+ tefach board within 3 tefachim) are genuinely different answers to related but distinct configurations.

questions.q: How is the (expanded) tefach wall actually constructed and positioned?
options: An expanded tefach within 3 tefachim of any wall
A doorway-shape with a tefach opposite the emerging wall
questions.explain: Between Shmuel/Levi, Rabbi Simon (or R' Yehoshua ben Levi), and Rava's three separately-reported versions, essentially every one of these methods appears as somebody's actual position — genuinely disputed across the board.

questions.q: Since the extra tefach counts as a wall for sukkah, it would also be considered a wall for the purposes of carrying on Shabbos.
questions.explain: Rava's miggo argument (sukkah-wall status carries over to Shabbos-wall status) applies specifically to Shabbos during Sukkot — and Abaye's challenge, even after being answered, leaves genuine dispute about the scope of that carryover.
